verdict.rationale: Netlify ships AI features (agent runners, AI Gateway, an AI chatbot), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage control for AI models. The access/secrets controls and privacy-until-publish deploys are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
